### Git

#### `ahead-behind`

**Ahead / Behind.** Commits ahead and behind the upstream as ↑2 ↓1, hiding a side that is zero.

**When:** A branch's sync state beside its name: sidebars, title bars, branch lists. For lines changed use `diff-counts`.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `ahead` | commits to push |
| `behind` | commits to pull |
| `synced` | when both are zero, show a muted check instead of nothing |
| `tooltip` | text under the pointer (default "2 ahead, 1 behind") |

**Styles:** `.ahead-behind` `.ahead-behind-ahead` `.ahead-behind-behind` `.ahead-behind-count` `.ahead-behind-part`

```lua
local ahead_behind = use "ahead-behind"

ahead_behind { ahead = 2, behind = 1 }
```

A whole mod using it, with state: `app/components/demos/ahead-behind.luau`.

#### `change-tree`

**Change Tree.** Changed files nested in their folders, single-child folders joined, with A, M or D at the right.

**When:** The changed files of a repository or a review, as the right pane's Changes shows `app.git.files`. For every file in a folder use `tree`; for a file's lines use `diff-view`.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `counts` | show each file's +added −deleted at the right |
| `files` | lines of "<status>\t<added>\t<deleted>\t<path>" (`app.projects.current.files`, or made from `app.git.files`) |
| `fold` | key of the message a folder sends, default "fold": { fold = path } |
| `folded` | folders folded shut: { [path] = true } |
| `indent` | pixels per level (default 14) |
| `mark` | where the status letter goes: "end" (default, at the right) or "start" (before the icon) |
| `pick` | key of the message a file sends, default "pick": { pick = path } |
| `plain` | outline folder and file icons instead of coloured ones by type |
| `selected` | the chosen file's path |
| `to` | the mod to send them to, if not the drawing one |

**Styles:** `.change-tree-added` `.change-tree-chevron` `.change-tree-deleted` `.change-tree-icon` `.change-tree-mark` `.change-tree-mark-added` `.change-tree-mark-conflict` `.change-tree-mark-deleted` `.change-tree-mark-modified` `.change-tree-mark-renamed` `.change-tree-row` `.change-tree-row:hover` `.change-tree-row:selected`

```lua
local change_tree = use "change-tree"

change_tree { files = { "A\t40\t0\tappleauth/appleauth.go", "M\t12\t3\tcmd/ryui/android.go", "M\t2\t1\tcmd/ryui/config.go", "M\t5\t0\tplatform/android/app/build.gradle.kts" }, selected = "cmd/ryui/config.go" }
```

#### `checks`

**Checks.** A CI/status box: "3 of 4 passed" header with an overall icon, then one row per check with a state icon (spinning when pending), name and detail.

**When:** CI runs or readiness factors for a pull request or branch: a PR detail pane, a merge dialog. For a single summary dot use `pr-badge` or `pr-row` with `checks`; for an agent's state use `status-dot`.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `checks` | list of { id, name, state = passed\|failed\|pending\|skipped\|cancelled, detail, msg } |
| `collapsed` | show only the header |
| `event` | row click message key: sends { [event] = id or name } (rows are not clickable without it or a row `msg`) |
| `title` | header text instead of the summary ("3 of 4 passed" stays beside it) |
| `to` | the mod to send it to |
| `toggle` | message the header sends on a click (to collapse or expand) |

**Styles:** `.checks` `.checks-detail` `.checks-failed` `.checks-header` `.checks-header:hover` `.checks-icon` `.checks-name` `.checks-passed` `.checks-pending` `.checks-row` `.checks-row:hover` `.checks-summary` `.checks-title`

```lua
local checks = use "checks"

checks { checks = { { detail = "4m 12s", name = "ci / test (ubuntu)", state = "passed" }, { detail = "6m 40s", name = "ci / test (macos)", state = "passed" }, { detail = "1 warning denied", name = "ci / clippy", state = "failed" }, { detail = "running 2m", name = "ci / build release", state = "pending" }, { detail = "Approved by alice", name = "Review", state = "passed" } } }
```

A whole mod using it, with state: `app/components/demos/checks.luau`.

#### `diff-counts`

**Diff Counts.** Lines added and removed as "+38 −16" in green and red mono, with an optional files count.

**When:** The size of a change beside a file, commit, branch or PR: file lists, rows, title bars. For commits ahead and behind use `ahead-behind`; for a whole diff use `diff-view`.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `added` | lines added |
| `files` | files changed: shows "3 files" first |
| `removed` | lines removed |
| `size` | small (default) \| normal |
| `zero` | show +0 and −0 instead of hiding a zero side |

**Styles:** `.diff-counts` `.diff-counts-added` `.diff-counts-files` `.diff-counts-removed`

```lua
local diff_counts = use "diff-counts"

diff_counts { added = 38, files = 3, removed = 16, size = "normal" }
```

A whole mod using it, with state: `app/components/demos/diff-counts.luau`.

#### `diff-view`

**Diff View.** One file's diff: header with status, path and +/− counts, @@ hunk rows, two line-number gutters, green and red washes; unified or split, collapsible, scrolling.

**When:** Show a file's changes for review: a review pane, a checkpoint, a commit. Stack one per file in a scrolling column. For only the size of a change use `diff-counts`; for a file without changes use `code-view`.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `actions` | elements at the header's right (buttons) |
| `collapsed` | show only the header |
| `event` | header click message key instead of "toggle": sends { [event] = path } |
| `grow` | fill the parent and scroll the body |
| `header` | false hides the file header |
| `height` | pixels: the body scrolls within it |
| `hunks` | list of { header = "@@ -1,15 +1,34 @@", lines = { { kind = add\|del\|ctx, old, new, text } } } |
| `path` | file path shown in the header |
| `split` | old and new side by side instead of unified |
| `status` | git status letter: A, M, D, R, U or ? |
| `switch` | message key for a unified/split toggle in the header: sends { [switch] = "unified" \| "split" } |
| `to` | the mod to send it to |

**Styles:** `.diff-view` `.diff-view-add` `.diff-view-blank` `.diff-view-body` `.diff-view-chevron` `.diff-view-del` `.diff-view-gutter` `.diff-view-header` `.diff-view-header:hover` `.diff-view-hunk` `.diff-view-hunk-text` `.diff-view-line` `.diff-view-number` `.diff-view-path` `.diff-view-sign` `.diff-view-sign-add` `.diff-view-sign-del` `.diff-view-split` `.diff-view-status` `.diff-view-status-added` `.diff-view-status-conflict` `.diff-view-status-deleted` `.diff-view-status-modified` `.diff-view-status-renamed` `.diff-view-status-untracked` `.diff-view-text`

```lua
local diff_view = use "diff-view"

	diff_view {
		path = "src/ledger.rs", status = "M", split = state.split,
		collapsed = state.collapsed["src/ledger.rs"], grow = true,
		hunks = {
			{ header = "@@ -1,8 +1,14 @@", lines = {
				{ kind = "add", new = 1, text = "use std::collections::HashMap;" },
				{ kind = "ctx", old = 1, new = 2, text = "#[derive(Default)]" },
				{ kind = "del", old = 2, text = "    entries: Vec<(String, i64)>," },
				{ kind = "add", new = 3, text = "    entries: Vec<Posting>," },
			} },
		},
	} -- the header sends { toggle = path }
```

A whole mod using it, with state: `app/components/demos/diff-view.luau`.

#### `pr-badge`

**PR Badge.** A PR, MR or issue number (#850, !3) as a pill tinted by state: draft, waiting, ready, attention, merged, closed, held; with a checks dot.

**When:** A pull or merge request referenced inline: beside a branch in a sidebar, in a title bar, in a tab. For a full list row use `pr-row`; for CI details use `checks`; for an agent's state use `status-dot`.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `checks` | passed \| failed \| pending: a small dot after the number |
| `icon` | an icon name instead of the tone's |
| `kind` | pr ("#", default) \| issue ("#") \| mr (GitLab, "!") |
| `label` | text after the number, e.g. "Ready" |
| `msg` | message sent on a click (e.g. { open = 850 }) |
| `number` | the PR, MR or issue number |
| `to` | the mod to send `msg` to |
| `tone` | draft \| waiting \| ready \| attention \| merged \| closed \| held (default waiting) |
| `tooltip` | text under the pointer (default the tone in words) |

**Styles:** `.pr-badge` `.pr-badge-attention` `.pr-badge-checks` `.pr-badge-checks-failed` `.pr-badge-checks-passed` `.pr-badge-checks-pending` `.pr-badge-closed` `.pr-badge-draft` `.pr-badge-held` `.pr-badge-label` `.pr-badge-merged` `.pr-badge-number` `.pr-badge-ready` `.pr-badge-waiting`

```lua
local pr_badge = use "pr-badge"

pr_badge { checks = "passed", label = "Ready", number = 850, tone = "ready" }
```

A whole mod using it, with state: `app/components/demos/pr-badge.luau`.

#### `pr-row`

**PR Row.** A pull request, MR or issue list row: state-coloured icon and number, title with draft tag, mono branch, author, checks dot, size and age; selectable.

**When:** Lists of pull requests, merge requests or issues, as in an orchestrator or review queue; stack rows in a scrolling column, under `section` headings per group. For a PR referenced inline use `pr-badge`; for a generic data grid use `table`; for its CI use `checks`.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `added` | lines added (with `removed`, shows diff counts) |
| `age` | age text, e.g. "2d" |
| `author` | author's login |
| `branch` | source branch, mono on the second line |
| `checks` | passed \| failed \| pending: a coloured dot |
| `comments` | comment count |
| `context` | sent on a right-click |
| `draft` | a draft tag after the title (and the draft icon) |
| `event` | message key instead of "select": sends { [event] = number } |
| `kind` | pr ("#", default) \| mr ("!") \| issue |
| `labels` | label names, as small tags after the title |
| `msg` | message sent instead |
| `number` | the PR, MR or issue number |
| `removed` | lines removed |
| `seconds` | age in seconds instead of `age` (shown compact) |
| `selected` | highlight it |
| `target` | target branch, shown as branch → target |
| `title` | the title |
| `to` | the mod to send it to |
| `tone` | draft \| waiting \| ready \| attention \| merged \| closed \| held: the icon's colour (default waiting) |

**Styles:** `.pr-row` `.pr-row:hover` `.pr-row:selected` `.pr-row-age` `.pr-row-branch` `.pr-row-branch-icon` `.pr-row-branch-text` `.pr-row-checks` `.pr-row-checks-failed` `.pr-row-checks-passed` `.pr-row-checks-pending` `.pr-row-draft` `.pr-row-draft-text` `.pr-row-icon` `.pr-row-icon-attention` `.pr-row-icon-closed` `.pr-row-icon-draft` `.pr-row-icon-held` `.pr-row-icon-merged` `.pr-row-icon-ready` `.pr-row-icon-waiting` `.pr-row-label` `.pr-row-label-text` `.pr-row-meta` `.pr-row-number` `.pr-row-ref` `.pr-row-title`

```lua
local pr_row = use "pr-row"

ui.column { gap = "none",
	pr_row { number = 3, kind = "mr", title = "Fix pagination of the merge request listing",
		branch = "fix/pagination", author = "alice", age = "2d", checks = "passed",
		selected = state.selected == 3 },
	pr_row { number = 2, kind = "mr", title = "Draft: cache MR pages", draft = true,
		branch = "wip/cache", author = "penso", age = "3d", checks = "pending" },
}
```

### Layout

#### `mockups`

**Mockups.** Variants of one change side by side, each live in a lettered card with a Pick button that copies which one to apply.

**When:** Showing the user a few ideas for a change before making it, so they can pick one: the moonframe-mockups skill builds a throwaway mod around it. Not for real content; for choosing between options inside the app use `choice-cards`.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `ask` | what the user asked for, shown on top and quoted in the pick |
| `file` | the mockup's file, quoted in the pick so the agent finds it |
| `variants` | list of { name, note?, body (an element or a list of elements) } |
| `width` | each card's width in pixels; default 360 |

**Styles:** `.mockups-card` `.mockups-letter` `.mockups-stage`

```lua
local mockups = use "mockups"

mockups { ask = "a busier status bar", file = "~/.config/moonframe/mods/mockup/main.luau", variants = {
	{ name = "Pills", note = "Each value in a pill.", body = ui.row { gap = "small", ui.badge "main", ui.badge "+3" } },
	{ name = "Plain", note = "Muted text, no chrome.", body = ui.text { "main · +3", tone = "muted" } },
} }
```

#### `page`

**Page.** A scrolling page with a title, subtitle and header actions over its content, and an optional pinned footer.

**When:** The main area of a settings screen, a detail view or a dashboard: a big title, then sections of content that scroll. Group its content with `section` or `card`; put it beside a `sidebar` in a `split-view`. For a framed pane use `pane-frame`; for a modal use `dialog`; for a panel in a sidebar use `ui.panel`.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `[children]` | the content |
| `actions` | elements on the header's right (buttons) |
| `footer` | element pinned under the scroll (a save bar) |
| `height` | fixed height in pixels; leave unset to fill the parent |
| `icon` | icon before the title |
| `subtitle` | muted line under the title |
| `title` | page title |
| `width` | the content's width in pixels, centred (omit to fill the page) |

**Styles:** `.page` `.page-content` `.page-footer` `.page-header` `.page-icon` `.page-scroll` `.page-subtitle` `.page-title`

```lua
local page = use "page"
local section = use "section"

page { title = "Sidebar", subtitle = "Changes apply to every open window immediately.",
	actions = { ui.button { "Reset", small = true, variant = "ghost", msg = "reset" } },
	width = 720,
	footer = ui.row { align = "center", gap = "normal",
		ui.text { "Unsaved: sidebar", tone = "warning" }, ui.spacer(),
		ui.button { "Save now", small = true, variant = "outline", msg = "save" },
	},
	section { title = "LAYOUT", ui.text "Layout preset" },
	section { title = "SPACING", ui.text "Indent" },
}
```

A whole mod using it, with state: `app/components/demos/page.luau`.

#### `pane-frame`

**Pane frame.** A framed pane card: header with icon, title, folder, status and split/zoom/close buttons over its body; accent border when focused.

**When:** Framing each pane of a tiled workspace (a terminal, an agent, a log) with its own header and controls. The panes' sizes come from `ui.hsplit`/`ui.vsplit` (see `split-view`); this only draws the frame inside one. For a titled box of content use `card`; for a sidebar panel use `ui.panel`.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `[children]` | the body: a `ui.terminal`, a log, any content |
| `actions` | more elements before the built-in buttons |
| `click_focus` | a click anywhere in the body that no control takes sends `focus` too |
| `close` | msg for the close button (omit to hide it) |
| `focus` | msg sent when the header's title is clicked |
| `focused` | accent border: the pane that takes keys |
| `header` | "top" (default) or "bottom" |
| `height` | fixed height in pixels; leave unset to fill the parent |
| `icon` | icon before the title (agent-claude, terminal, git-branch...) |
| `leading` | elements before the icon (a status dot) |
| `menu` | msg for a chevron after the title (a menu of what the pane shows); omit for none |
| `split_down` | msg for the split-down button (omit to hide it) |
| `split_right` | msg for the split-right button (omit to hide it) |
| `status` | working (spinner), blocked (a "Needs you" chip), done or idle (a dot) |
| `subtitle` | muted text after the title: the folder, `~/code/app` |
| `title` | the program or agent's name |
| `to` | mod to send the msgs to, if not the drawing one |
| `zoom` | msg for the zoom button (omit to hide it) |
| `zoomed` | the zoom button shows restore |

**Styles:** `.pane-frame` `.pane-frame-body` `.pane-frame-chevron` `.pane-frame-focus` `.pane-frame-focused` `.pane-frame-header` `.pane-frame-header-bottom` `.pane-frame-header-top` `.pane-frame-icon` `.pane-frame-menu` `.pane-frame-menu:hover` `.pane-frame-subtitle` `.pane-frame-title`

```lua
local pane_frame = use "pane-frame"

pane_frame { title = "claude", icon = "agent-claude", subtitle = "~/code/ledger-api",
	status = "blocked", focused = state.focus == "agent",
	focus = { focus = "agent" }, split_right = { split = "right" }, split_down = { split = "down" },
	zoom = "zoom", close = { close = "agent" },
	ui.terminal { id = "agent", cwd = "~/code/ledger-api" },
}
```

A whole mod using it, with state: `app/components/demos/pane-frame.luau`.

#### `settings-page`

**Settings page.** A settings window body: grouped nav on the left, a scrolling page of titled sections and setting rows, a save-status footer.

**When:** A whole preferences window or settings tab. It is made of `settings-nav` (the page list) and `settings-row` (each setting); use those directly for a different arrangement, `section` for a plain heading, `card` to box a group.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `[children]` | page content after the sections |
| `buttons` | footer buttons { { label, msg, variant } }; default a Reload button sending `"reload"` |
| `height` | pixels; otherwise it fills its parent |
| `nav` | props for `settings-nav`: { groups, selected, search, title, footer, event } |
| `sections` | list of { title = "Layout", description, rows = { { title, description, tag, disabled, reason, stacked, control } }, content = { elements } } |
| `state` | `saved` (default), `unsaved` (warning dot) or `error` (danger dot) |
| `status` | footer text; default "All changes saved." |
| `subtitle` | muted line under the title |
| `title` | the page's title ("Sidebar") |
| `to` | mod the footer buttons send to, if not the drawing one |

**Styles:** `.settings-page` `.settings-page-dot` `.settings-page-dot-error` `.settings-page-dot-unsaved` `.settings-page-footer` `.settings-page-head` `.settings-page-heading` `.settings-page-main` `.settings-page-scroll` `.settings-page-section` `.settings-page-section-description` `.settings-page-status` `.settings-page-subtitle` `.settings-page-title`

```lua
local settings_page = use "settings-page"
local switch = use "switch"

settings_page {
	nav = { groups = NAV_GROUPS, selected = state.page },
	title = "Sidebar", subtitle = "Changes apply to every open window immediately.",
	sections = {
		{ title = "Layout", rows = {
			{ title = "Show agents", description = "List running agents under their workspace.",
				control = switch { on = state.show_agents, msg = "toggle-agents" } },
		} },
	},
	status = state.dirty and "Unsaved: sidebar" or "All changes saved.",
	state = state.dirty and "unsaved" or "saved",
}
```

A whole mod using it, with state: `app/components/demos/settings-page.luau`.

#### `side-panels`

**Side Panels.** Sidebar, list and main area side by side; hiding the sidebar or the list folds it away while it fades, and the rest slides over.

**When:** A three-column app (notes, mail, writing) whose sidebar and list the user hides to focus on the main area. The mod keeps `left` and `middle` and flips them from buttons in the panes' headers. For resizable panes, an inspector or a bottom panel use `split-view`; for a switcher over the list use `pill-tabs`.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `height` | fixed height in pixels; leave unset to fill the parent |
| `id` | the split's id (default "side-panels") |
| `left` | show the sidebar (default true) |
| `list` | element in the middle pane |
| `list_size` | list width in pixels (default 280) |
| `main` | element in the main area |
| `middle` | show the list (default true) |
| `sidebar` | element in the left pane |
| `sidebar_size` | sidebar width in pixels (default 220) |

**Styles:** `.side-panels-list` `.side-panels-main` `.side-panels-sidebar`

```lua
local side_panels = use "side-panels"

side_panels {
	left = state.left, middle = state.middle,
	sidebar = ui.region "left",
	list = ui.region "list",
	main = ui.region "main",
}
-- update: flip state.left / state.middle from icon buttons in the panes' headers.
```

A whole mod using it, with state: `app/components/demos/side-panels.luau`.

#### `split-view`

**Split view.** Sidebar, main area, inspector and bottom panel in resizable splits, each side shown or hidden by a prop.

**When:** The body of a shell or a large mod: a sidebar, the main content and optional inspector and bottom panes the user can resize and toggle. It is plain `ui.hsplit`/`ui.vsplit` with `ui.pane` children; write those directly for any other arrangement. For framing each pane use `pane-frame`; for a scrolling page inside the main area use `page`.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `bottom` | show the bottom panel (default true when given) |
| `bottom_panel` | element in the pane under the main area (a terminal, logs) |
| `bottom_size` | bottom panel height in pixels (default 200) |
| `height` | fixed height in pixels; leave unset to fill the parent, as splits do |
| `id` | prefix for the splits' ids, so the user's sizes are kept (default "split-view") |
| `inspector` | element in the right pane |
| `inspector_size` | inspector width in pixels (default 300) |
| `left` | show the sidebar (default true when given) |
| `main` | element in the main pane |
| `right` | show the inspector (default true when given) |
| `sidebar` | element in the left pane (a `sidebar`, a `ui.region`) |
| `sidebar_size` | sidebar width in pixels (default 260) |

**Styles:** `.split-view-bottom` `.split-view-inspector` `.split-view-main` `.split-view-sidebar`

```lua
local split_view = use "split-view"
local sidebar = use "sidebar"

split_view {
	left = state.left, right = state.right, bottom = state.bottom,
	sidebar = ui.region "left",
	main = ui.region "main",
	inspector = ui.region "right",
	bottom_panel = ui.terminal { id = "bottom", cwd = "~/code/ledger-api" },
}
-- update: flip state.left / state.right / state.bottom from toolbar buttons.
```

A whole mod using it, with state: `app/components/demos/split-view.luau`.

### Lists

#### `board-card`

**Board Card.** A kanban card: title with a badge, a muted line, then an amount, a date and the owner's initials; a tone outlines it.

**When:** Items in a `kanban-column`: deals, tickets, tasks, candidates. For a row in a list use `task-row` or `list`; for a pull request use `pr-row`.

| --- | --- |
| `amount` | the figure at the bottom left |
| `badge` | a small label on the right ("30%", "Won", "At risk") |
| `badge_tone` | the badge's tone: success, danger, warning or muted (default) |
| `context` | message a right-click sends (a menu of moves) |
| `date` | a date beside it |
| `msg` | message a click sends |
| `owner` | the owner's initials, in a round avatar |
| `owner_color` | the avatar's colour |
| `selected` | highlight it |
| `subtitle` | a muted line under it |
| `title` | what it is (a company, a ticket's title) |
| `to` | mod to send them to, if not the drawing one |
| `tone` | outline it: danger (at risk), warning, success |

**Styles:** `.board-card` `.board-card:hover` `.board-card:selected` `.board-card-amount` `.board-card-badge` `.board-card-date` `.board-card-foot` `.board-card-sub` `.board-card-title`

```lua
local board_card = use "board-card"

board_card { amount = "$98,000", badge = "At risk", badge_tone = "danger", date = "Nov 13", owner = "TO", subtitle = "Platform renewal", title = "Lumen Retail", tone = "danger" }
```

#### `group-header`

**Group header.** A list group heading: status dot or icon, title, count, fold chevron and a trailing + action.

**When:** A heading inside a list that groups its rows by state or owner ("Needs you 3", "Waiting 3", a machine with its online dot). For a sidebar's own sections use `sidebar-section`; for a heading over arbitrary content use `section`; for nested rows use `tree`.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `actions` | more elements before the + |
| `add` | msg for a trailing + button (omit for none) |
| `add_tooltip` | tooltip of the + button |
| `band` | draw it on a tinted band across the list, as over merge requests |
| `collapsed` | draw the chevron folded |
| `count` | number after the title |
| `detail` | muted text after the count (a host name, `online`) |
| `icon` | an icon before the title instead of a dot (server, laptop, agent-claude) |
| `id` | id for the default toggle msg (default the title) |
| `status` | a status dot before the title: working, blocked, done, idle, unknown |
| `title` | heading text |
| `to` | mod to send the msgs to, if not the drawing one |
| `toggle` | msg sent when the heading is clicked; default `{ toggle = id }`. `false` makes it a plain heading with no chevron |

**Styles:** `.group-header` `.group-header-band` `.group-header-button` `.group-header-button:hover` `.group-header-chevron` `.group-header-count` `.group-header-detail` `.group-header-icon` `.group-header-title` `.group-header-toggle`

```lua
local group_header = use "group-header"

ui.column { gap = "none",
	group_header { title = "Needs you", status = "blocked", count = 2, collapsed = state.folded.blocked,
		toggle = { fold = "blocked" }, add = "new-agent" },
	-- the group's rows...
	group_header { title = "studio", icon = "server", status = "idle", detail = "online", count = 4, add = { new_on = "studio" } },
}
```

A whole mod using it, with state: `app/components/demos/group-header.luau`.

#### `kanban-column`

**Kanban Column.** A board column: dot, title, count and total over a coloured rule, its cards, then an Add button.

**When:** Each stage of a kanban board (deals, tickets, tasks by status); put several in a row that scrolls sideways and fill them with `board-card`. For a list grouped by status without columns use `group-header` over rows.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `[children]` | the cards |
| `add` | message the Add button sends; no button without it |
| `add_label` | the button's text (default "Add") |
| `color` | the dot's and rule's colour (default accent) |
| `count` | how many cards, in a small badge |
| `title` | the stage's name |
| `to` | mod to send `add` to, if not the drawing one |
| `total` | a figure on the right ("$412K") |

```lua
local kanban_column = use "kanban-column"
local board_card = use "board-card"

kanban_column {
	title = "Proposal", color = "#a78bfa", count = 3, total = "$284K", add = { add = "proposal" },
```

#### `level-row`

**Level Row.** A capitalised label, a rounded track filled to a fraction with a gradient, and its count.

**When:** Rows of a breakdown where each part is read on its own scale: leads by status, a funnel's stages, tickets by priority. For parts of one whole with shares use `ratio-row` or `share-bar`; for one fraction with a percentage use `meter`; for a quota use `usage-bar`.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `color` | the fill's colour at its start (default accent) |
| `end_color` | the fill's colour at its end, for a gradient (default `color`) |
| `fraction` | 0 to 1: how far the fill goes |
| `height` | the track's height in pixels (default 20) |
| `label` | what it counts, shown in capitals |
| `label_width` | the label column's width in pixels (default 120) |
| `msg` | message a click sends |
| `to` | mod to send `msg` to, if not the drawing one |
| `tooltip` | text under the pointer |
| `value` | the count at the end, as text |
| `width` | the track's width in pixels (default 200) |

**Styles:** `.level-row` `.level-row-fill` `.level-row-label` `.level-row-track` `.level-row-value`

```lua
local level_row = use "level-row"

level_row { color = "#5fdcff", end_color = "#00a8ff", fraction = 0.8, label = "New leads", value = "134", width = 220 }
```

#### `list`

**List.** Selectable rows with a label, detail and badge; a click sends { select = id } to the mod drawing it.

**When:** A plain selectable list of rows with label, detail and badge. For rich rows (status, icons, two lines) use `agent-row`, `workspace-row` or `tree`.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `rows` | list of { id, label, detail, badge } |
| `selected` | id of the selected row |
| `to` | mod to send { select = id } to, if not the drawing one |

```lua
local list = use "list"

list { rows = { { badge = "3", detail = "~/code/app", id = "main", label = "main" }, { badge = "new", detail = "~/code/app-inspect", id = "feature", label = "feature/inspect" }, { badge = "1", detail = "~/code/app-menus", id = "fix", label = "fix/menus" } }, selected = "main" }
```

#### `ratio-row`

**Ratio Row.** A label with its count and share at the right, after an icon, with an optional thin bar under it as long as the share.

**When:** Lists of parts of a whole: where signups came from, top countries, devices, tiers. Stack them in a column; give `share` for the bar under each. For a bar of all the parts at once use `share-bar`; for a data grid use `table`.

| Prop | Meaning |

| `color` | the bar's colour (default accent) |
| `count` | its count, muted |
| `icon` | icon in a small tile before the label |
| `label` | what the part is |
| `leading` | an element instead of the icon (a `country-code`, a dot) |
| `msg` | message a click sends |
| `percent` | its share, bold ("42%") |
| `share` | 0 to 100: draw a bar under the row this long |
| `to` | mod to send `msg` to, if not the drawing one |
| `width` | the bar's full width in pixels (default 360) |

**Styles:** `.ratio-row` `.ratio-row-count` `.ratio-row-fill` `.ratio-row-icon` `.ratio-row-line` `.ratio-row-percent` `.ratio-row-track`

```lua
local ratio_row = use "ratio-row"

ratio_row { color = "#7c5cff", count = "604", icon = "globe", label = "Website signup form", percent = "44%", share = 44 }
```

#### `task-row`

**Task Row.** A task (round check, title struck through when done) or an event (a dot), with date, due time and tag pills under it.

**When:** Rows of tasks, to-dos, habits or events in a planner, an inbox or a day view; stack them in a column under `section` headings. For a plain selectable row use `list`; for pull requests use `pr-row`.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `context` | message a right-click sends (a menu, or cycling its priority) |
| `date` | its date, as shown ("Sat, Oct 31") |
| `due` | the time in the danger colour: due or late |
| `event` | an event: a dot instead of a check |
| `icon` | an icon before the date (a habit's flame) |
| `leading` | an element instead of the check (an emoji for a note) |
| `msg` | message a click on the row sends (open it) |
| `selected` | the row is the chosen one |
| `state` | the check: open (default), important, progress or done |
| `tags` | pills after the time: { label, color? or tone?, icon? } |
| `time` | its time ("17:00") |
| `title` | what to do |
| `to` | mod to send both to, if not the drawing one |
| `toggle` | message the check sends |

**Styles:** `.task-row` `.task-row:hover` `.task-row:selected` `.task-row-body` `.task-row-done` `.task-row-due` `.task-row-event` `.task-row-line` `.task-row-meta` `.task-row-title`

```lua

task_row { date = "Sat, Oct 31", due = true, state = "progress", tags = { { color = "#3b82f6", label = "Work" } }, time = "17:00", title = "Review the launch checklist" }
```

#### `tree`

**Tree.** Indented rows with fold chevrons and optional │ ├ └ guide lines; sends { select = id } and { fold = id }.

**When:** Nested rows: a file tree in a review, worktrees under a repository, agents and their sub-agents. For flat rows use `list`; for a heading over a group of rows use `group-header`; for one foldable block use `collapsible`.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `fold` | key of the msg sent on a chevron click; default `fold`, sending `{ fold = id }` |
| `guides` | draw │ ├ └ guide lines between levels |
| `indent` | pixels per level (default 16) |
| `nodes` | list of { id, label, detail?, icon?, tone? (icon tone), trailing? (elements on the right), children? (nodes), expanded?, msg? }; a node with children and no icon gets a folder |
| `select` | key of the msg sent on a row click; default `select`, sending `{ select = id }` |
| `selected` | id of the selected node |
| `to` | mod to send the msgs to, if not the drawing one |

**Styles:** `.tree` `.tree-chevron` `.tree-chevron:hover` `.tree-content` `.tree-detail` `.tree-guide` `.tree-guide-arm` `.tree-icon` `.tree-label` `.tree-row` `.tree-row:hover` `.tree-row:selected`

```lua
local tree = use "tree"

tree { selected = state.selected, guides = true, nodes = {
	{ id = "src", label = "src", expanded = true, children = loose {
		{ id = "src/ledger.rs", label = "ledger.rs", icon = "file", tone = "warning",
			trailing = { ui.badge { "M", tone = "warning" } } },
		{ id = "src/main.rs", label = "main.rs", icon = "file" },
	} },
} }
-- update: msg.select opens a node; msg.fold flips its `expanded` in state.
```

A whole mod using it, with state: `app/components/demos/tree.luau`.

### Navigation

#### `activity-bar`

**Activity bar.** A vertical column of icon tiles for switching views, the current one on an accent tile, with count bubbles.

**When:** Switching between the app's main views from a thin strip at the window's edge (terminals, pull requests, issues, agents, settings). For a collapsed list of workspaces use `rail`; for text tabs use `tabs`; for a full list of rows use `sidebar`.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `bottom` | items pinned to the bottom (settings, account), same shape |
| `event` | key of the msg sent on click; default `activity`, sending `{ activity = id }` |
| `fill` | grow to fill a column parent's height (in a `ui.pane`, say); in a row it already stretches |
| `height` | fixed height in pixels; in a row it stretches to the row's height |
| `items` | list of { id, icon, tooltip?, count? (number or text: a bubble on the corner), msg? } |
| `selected` | id of the current item, drawn on an accent tile |
| `to` | mod to send the msg to, if not the drawing one |

**Styles:** `.activity-bar` `.activity-bar-count` `.activity-bar-icon` `.activity-bar-item` `.activity-bar-item:hover` `.activity-bar-item:selected`

```lua
-- An app's main.luau: the bar picks which region the side pane shows.
-- Each view's mods declare that region (`region = "files"`), and keep
-- their state while hidden. Clicking the current view folds the pane.
local activity_bar = use "activity-bar"

local VIEWS = {
	{ id = "files", icon = "file-text", tooltip = "Explorer" },
	{ id = "search", icon = "search", tooltip = "Search" },
	{ id = "changes", icon = "git-branch", tooltip = "Changes" },
}

return mod {
	init = function(previous)
		return previous or { activity = "files", open = true }
	end,

	update = function(state, msg)
		if typeof(msg) == "table" and msg.activity then
			state.open = not (state.open and state.activity == msg.activity)
			state.activity = msg.activity
		end
	end,

	view = function(state)
		return ui.row {
			gap = "none",
			grow = true,
			activity_bar {
				items = VIEWS,
				selected = state.open and state.activity or nil,
				bottom = { { id = "settings", icon = "settings", tooltip = "Settings" } },
			},
			ui.hsplit {
				id = "body",
				ui.pane { size = 260, min = 160, max = 480, fixed = true, visible = state.open, surface = "sidebar", ui.region(state.activity) },
				ui.pane { ui.region "main" },
			},
		}
	end,
}
```

A whole mod using it, with state: `app/components/demos/activity-bar.luau`.

#### `breadcrumbs`

**Breadcrumbs.** Crumbs with chevron separators, clickable earlier crumbs, an optional back arrow, "2 of 3" steppers and actions.

**When:** Where a detail view sits in a hierarchy (repository › Pull requests › !2), with a way back up and to step through siblings. For a window's top row use `title-bar`; for switching views use `tabs`; for a pane's own header use `pane-frame`.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `actions` | elements on the right (open in a window, close) |
| `back` | msg for a back arrow before the crumbs (omit for none) |
| `crumbs` | list of { label, icon?, id?, msg? }; all but the last are clickable |
| `down` | msg for the next sibling; nil greys the stepper out |
| `event` | key of a crumb's default msg; default `crumb`, sending `{ crumb = id or index }` |
| `position` | text such as "2 of 3" before the steppers |
| `to` | mod to send the msgs to, if not the drawing one |
| `up` | msg for the previous sibling; nil greys the stepper out |

**Styles:** `.breadcrumbs` `.breadcrumbs-crumb` `.breadcrumbs-crumb:hover` `.breadcrumbs-current` `.breadcrumbs-position` `.breadcrumbs-separator` `.breadcrumbs-step` `.breadcrumbs-step:hover` `.breadcrumbs-step-off`

```lua
local breadcrumbs = use "breadcrumbs"

breadcrumbs {
	back = "back",
	crumbs = {
		{ label = "group/sub/app", icon = "brand-gitlab", id = "repo" },
		{ label = "Merge requests", icon = "git-pull-request", id = "pulls" },
		{ label = "!2 Draft: cache MR pages" },
	},
	position = "2 of 3", up = "previous", down = "next",
	actions = { ui.row { msg = "close", ui.icon "close" } },
}
-- update: msg.crumb is the clicked crumb's id (or its index).
```

A whole mod using it, with state: `app/components/demos/breadcrumbs.luau`.

#### `nav-buttons`

**Nav Buttons.** Back and forward chevrons as one capsule; each side disables when it cannot go. Sends `back` and `forward`.

**When:** History navigation in a title bar, a browser tab or a pane that keeps a back stack. For onboarding steps use `pager`; for a single icon action use `icon-button`.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `back` | message the back chevron sends (default "back") |
| `can_back` | false greys out the back chevron (default true) |
| `can_forward` | false greys out the forward chevron (default true) |
| `forward` | message the forward chevron sends (default "forward") |
| `small` | a smaller capsule |
| `to` | mod to send messages to, if not the drawing one |

**Styles:** `.nav-buttons` `.nav-buttons-button` `.nav-buttons-button:hover` `.nav-buttons-disabled` `.nav-buttons-separator` `.nav-buttons-small`

```lua
local nav_buttons = use "nav-buttons"

nav_buttons { back = "back", can_back = true, can_forward = false, forward = "forward" }
```

#### `pager`

**Pager.** Dots for pages with the current one stretched, and optional Back and Next buttons; sends `back`, `next` or { page = n }.

**When:** Steps of an onboarding or welcome flow, or pages of a carousel. For history back/forward use `nav-buttons`; for switching views use `tabs` or `segmented`.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `back` | message the Back button sends; no button when unset (hidden on the first page) |
| `back_label` | Back button text (default "Back") |
| `count` | number of pages |
| `event` | key of the message a dot sends, default "page": { page = n } |
| `next` | message the Next button sends; no button when unset |
| `next_label` | Next button text (default "Next"; e.g. "Get started" on the last page) |
| `page` | current page, from 1 |
| `to` | mod to send messages to, if not the drawing one |

**Styles:** `.pager` `.pager-dot` `.pager-dot:hover` `.pager-dot:selected` `.pager-dots`

```lua
local pager = use "pager"

pager { back = "back", count = 4, next = "next", page = 2 }
```

A whole mod using it, with state: `app/components/demos/pager.luau`.

#### `pagination`

**Pagination.** Page buttons for a long table or list: a Viewing x to y of n summary, previous and next, numbered pages with the current one outlined, gaps, and an items-per-page dropdown.

**When:** Under a table or list too long to show at once (an audit log, orders, invoices), when the user steps through it by page. For a list that scrolls use `ui.list`; for steps of an onboarding flow use `pager`; for history use `nav-buttons`.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `ellipsis` | false shows a sliding run of `window` pages instead of first … run … last |
| `event` | key of the message a page button sends, default "page": { page = n } |
| `noun` | what the items are, for the summary (default "items") |
| `page` | the current page, from 1 |
| `per_page` | items on a page (default 15) |
| `size_dismiss` | message sent on a click outside the page-size menu |
| `size_event` | key of the message a size sends, default "per_page": { per_page = n } |
| `size_label` | text before the page-size button (default "Items per page") |
| `size_open` | true while the page-size menu shows |
| `size_toggle` | message the page-size button sends (open or close) |
| `sizes` | page sizes for the Items per page dropdown, e.g. { 15, 30, 50 }; no dropdown without it |
| `summary` | false hides the "Viewing 1 to 15 of 145 items" text |
| `to` | mod to send messages to, if not the drawing one |
| `total` | how many items there are in all |
| `window` | most page buttons shown (default 7) |

**Styles:** `.pagination` `.pagination-button` `.pagination-button:hover` `.pagination-button:selected` `.pagination-chevron` `.pagination-disabled` `.pagination-gap` `.pagination-pages` `.pagination-size` `.pagination-size-button` `.pagination-size-button:hover` `.pagination-size-label` `.pagination-strong` `.pagination-summary`

```lua
local pagination = use "pagination"

pagination {
	page = state.page, total = #rows, per_page = state.per_page, noun = "activities",
	sizes = { 15, 30, 50 }, size_open = state.size_open,
	size_toggle = "toggle-size", size_dismiss = "close-size",
}
-- update: msg.page goes to that page; msg.per_page sets the size (and
-- closes the menu, back to page 1); "toggle-size" / "close-size" open and
-- close it.
```

A whole mod using it, with state: `app/components/demos/pagination.luau`.

#### `side-nav`

**Side Nav.** A sidebar of icon rows under section headings that folds to an icon rail: the width eases, icons stay put, and labels, headings and counts fade out and in one after another.

**When:** An app's main navigation that the user folds to icons and back (mail folders, views, projects, threads), with an account header and counts. For workspace tiles with status use `rail` beside a `sidebar`; for foldable groups of arbitrary rows use `sidebar`; for a VS Code strip beside a panel use `activity-bar`.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `account` | { name, initial?, color?, badge? (a pill after the name), subtitle?, menu? (msg for the chevron) }: the header; in the rail its avatar unfolds the sidebar |
| `collapsed` | fold to the icon rail |
| `event` | key of the msg an item sends, default `select`: { select = id } |
| `footer` | items pinned to the bottom, same shape (Settings, Support) |
| `header` | an element instead of `account`, drawn as is |
| `height` | fixed height in pixels; in a row it stretches to the row's height |
| `sections` | list of { title?, items = { { id, label, icon? or dot? (a colour), count? (number, 99+ past 99, or text), detail? (a second muted line), meta? (top right text), mark? (a colour dot under meta), primary? (stronger text), tooltip?, msg? } } } |
| `selected` | id of the current item, drawn raised as a card |
| `stagger` | milliseconds between one item's fade and the next (default 12); 0 fades them together |
| `to` | mod to send the msgs to, if not the drawing one |
| `toggle` | msg the header's fold button (and the rail's avatar) sends; no button without it |

**Styles:** `.side-nav` `.side-nav:full` `.side-nav:rail` `.side-nav-avatar` `.side-nav-avatar:hover` `.side-nav-badge` `.side-nav-body` `.side-nav-button` `.side-nav-button:hover` `.side-nav-count` `.side-nav-detail` `.side-nav-dot` `.side-nav-fade` `.side-nav-fade:hidden` `.side-nav-fade:shown` `.side-nav-foot` `.side-nav-head` `.side-nav-item` `.side-nav-item:hover` `.side-nav-item:selected` `.side-nav-item-primary` `.side-nav-mark` `.side-nav-meta` `.side-nav-name` `.side-nav-slot` `.side-nav-subtitle` `.side-nav-title` `.side-nav-two-line`

```lua
local side_nav = use "side-nav"

side_nav {
	collapsed = state.collapsed, toggle = "fold", selected = state.selected,
	account = { name = "Jay", badge = "Personal", subtitle = "Alex's Workspace", color = "#7c3aed" },
	sections = {
		{ items = {
			{ id = "compose", icon = "square-pen", label = "Compose", primary = true },
			{ id = "search", icon = "search", label = "Search" },
		} },
		{ title = "View", items = {
			{ id = "inbox", icon = "inbox", label = "Inbox", count = 128 },
			{ id = "starred", icon = "star", label = "Starred", count = 2 },
		} },
		{ title = "Label", items = {
			{ id = "work", dot = "#8b5cf6", label = "Work", count = 12 },
		} },
	},
	footer = { { id = "settings", icon = "settings", label = "Settings" } },
}
-- update: "fold" flips state.collapsed; msg.select is the chosen item's id.
```

#### `sidebar`

**Sidebar.** A full sidebar column: header slot, foldable sections of rows with counts and actions, footer links.

**When:** The whole left column of an app: workspaces, agents, settings categories. One group alone is `sidebar-section`; the narrow collapsed form is `rail`; a VS Code style icon strip beside it is `activity-bar`; nested rows are `tree`.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `[children]` | extra content after the sections, inside the scroll |
| `fill` | false to size to its content instead of filling the pane (no scrolling); default true |
| `footer` | list of { icon, label, msg, to?, dot? (accent dot: an update ready), muted?, tooltip? } pinned to the bottom |
| `header` | element at the top, outside the scroll (a brand row, a search field) |
| `height` | fixed height in pixels; leave unset inside a pane, where it fills the height |
| `sections` | list of { title, id?, count?, actions? (elements), collapsed?, toggle? msg, [rows as elements] }; count defaults to the number of rows |
| `to` | mod to send section toggles and footer msgs to, if not the drawing one |
| `width` | fixed width in pixels; leave unset inside a sized pane |

**Styles:** `.sidebar` `.sidebar-body` `.sidebar-brand` `.sidebar-brand-mark` `.sidebar-example-row` `.sidebar-example-row:hover` `.sidebar-example-row:selected` `.sidebar-footer` `.sidebar-footer-dot` `.sidebar-footer-muted` `.sidebar-footer-row` `.sidebar-footer-row:hover` `.sidebar-header`

```lua
local sidebar = use "sidebar"

sidebar {
	header = ui.row { align = "center", gap = "normal",
		ui.text { "Moonframe", weight = "bold" }, ui.spacer(),
		ui.row { msg = "search", ui.icon "search" },
	},
	sections = {
		{ title = "Spaces", id = "spaces", collapsed = state.folded.spaces,
			actions = { ui.button { "new", small = true, variant = "ghost", msg = "new" } },
			ui.item { "ledger-api", detail = "main", selected = true, msg = { open = "ledger-api" } },
			ui.item { "pixel-forge", detail = "main", msg = { open = "pixel-forge" } },
		},
		{ title = "Agents", id = "agents", collapsed = state.folded.agents,
			ui.item { "feat-multi-currency", detail = "claude", msg = { open = "feat" } },
		},
	},
	footer = {
		{ icon = "settings", label = "Settings", msg = "settings", dot = app.update_ready },
		{ icon = "plus", label = "Add machine", msg = "add-machine", muted = true },
	},
}
-- update: msg.toggle is the section id (or title) to fold or unfold.
```

#### `sidebar-section`

**Sidebar section.** A foldable sidebar group: uppercase heading, count, trailing actions and chevron over its rows.

**When:** A titled group of rows inside a sidebar ("Spaces", "Agents", "APPEARANCE"). The whole column is `sidebar`; a list heading with a status dot and `+` is `group-header`; a foldable card in a page is `collapsible`; a plain non-folding heading is `section`.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `[children]` | the rows |
| `actions` | elements on the heading's right (icon buttons, small text buttons) |
| `collapsed` | hide the rows |
| `count` | number shown after the title (omit for none) |
| `fixed` | no chevron and no click: the rows always show |
| `id` | id for the default toggle msg (default the title) |
| `title` | heading text, shown uppercase |
| `to` | mod to send the msg to, if not the drawing one |
| `toggle` | msg sent when the heading is clicked; default `{ toggle = id }` |

**Styles:** `.sidebar-section` `.sidebar-section-body` `.sidebar-section-chevron` `.sidebar-section-count` `.sidebar-section-header` `.sidebar-section-title` `.sidebar-section-toggle` `.sidebar-section-toggle:hover`

```lua
local section = use "sidebar-section"

section { title = "Agents", count = 3, collapsed = state.agents_folded, toggle = "fold-agents",
	actions = { ui.button { "grouped", small = true, variant = "ghost", msg = "group" } },
	ui.item { "ledger-api", detail = "claude", selected = true, msg = { open = "ledger-api" } },
	ui.item { "pixel-forge", detail = "codex", msg = { open = "pixel-forge" } },

}
```

#### `tab-view`

**Tab view.** One tab's content from its record: its component with the tab's props, or an instance of its mod.

**When:** Drawing the selected tab of a `tabbed` bar somewhere other than under it, from the `tabs/<id>` topic. `tabbed` uses it for its own content.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `kind` | its entry in `app.kinds` |
| `tab` | the tab: { id, kind, title?, props }, as `tabbed` publishes it |

```lua
local tab_view = use "tab-view"

-- in a mod that subscribes to "tabs/main":
tab_view { tab = state.tab, kind = kind_of(app.kinds, state.tab.kind) }
```

#### `tabbed`

**Tabbed.** A tab bar that keeps its tabs, which are saved: + opens a menu of kinds (terminals, browsers, files, any component or mod with a `tab` entry), and each tab shows its kind.

**When:** Several terminals, browsers or tools in one place, opened and closed by the user, remembered across launches. For a strip whose tabs the mod keeps itself use `tabs`.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | names this tab bar: its tabs are kept under it, and published on `tabs/<id>` |
| `offer` | kinds the + menu offers; all of `app.kinds` when unset |
| `show` | "bar" draws only the strip, its content drawn elsewhere from the `tabs/<id>` topic with `tab-view`; "both" (default) draws the content under it |
| `start` | kind of the first tab, as `app.kinds` names it ("component:terminal") |
| `variant` | the strip's look, as `tabs` takes it; by default the stylesheet's `looks.tabs`, else "classic" |

```lua
local tabbed = use "tabbed"

tabbed { id = "example", start = "component:terminal" }
```

#### `tabs`

**Tabs.** A tab strip in several looks (pills, underline, outline, cards, compact, classic, square, curved, browser) with icons, agent status, badges, close and add buttons; tabs grow in as they open and shrink away as they close.

**When:** Switch between open documents, terminals or agent sessions, or between views of one panel. For 2 to 4 settings choices use `segmented`; for joined action buttons use `button-group`; for onboarding steps use `pager`.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `add` | message for a + button after the tabs; no button when unset |
| `add_menu` | a menu the + button opens under itself: { open, dismiss (message on a click outside), content, width? } |
| `closable` | show × on every tab, not only the selected one |
| `close` | key of the message the × sends, default "close": { close = id } |
| `context` | key of the message a right-click sends, default "tab_menu": { tab_menu = id } |
| `event` | key of the message a click sends, default "select": { select = id } |
| `grow` | stretch the tabs to share the width equally |
| `in_bar` | drawn in a title bar or toolbar with its own bottom line: the strip draws no line of its own (`.tabs-in-bar`) |
| `selected` | id of the selected tab |
| `tabs` | list of { id, label, icon?, status? ("working" spinner, "blocked", "done", "idle" dot), badge? (count or text), closable? (false: never a ×), tooltip?, msg? (sent instead of the select message) } |
| `to` | mod to send messages to, if not the drawing one |
| `variant` | "pills" (default), "underline", "outline", "cards", "compact", "classic", "square" "curved" (the selected tab joins what is under the strip: put the strip right on top of a card of the same color) or "browser" (grey fixed-width tabs, the selected one white and raised: give `width`); or any look a stylesheet defines with `.tabs-<look>` and `.tabs-<look>-tab` rules |
| `width` | each tab's width in pixels: labels truncate and the × sits at the far end, as in a browser |

**Styles:** `.tabs` `.tabs-add` `.tabs-add:hover` `.tabs-badge` `.tabs-browser` `.tabs-browser-tab` `.tabs-browser-tab:hover` `.tabs-browser-tab:selected` `.tabs-cards` `.tabs-cards-tab` `.tabs-cards-tab:hover` `.tabs-cards-tab:selected` `.tabs-classic` `.tabs-classic-tab` `.tabs-classic-tab:hover` `.tabs-classic-tab:selected` `.tabs-close` `.tabs-close:hover` `.tabs-compact` `.tabs-compact-tab` `.tabs-compact-tab:selected` `.tabs-curved` `.tabs-curved-tab` `.tabs-curved-tab:hover` `.tabs-curved-tab:selected` `.tabs-dot` `.tabs-dot-blocked` `.tabs-dot-done` `.tabs-dot-idle` `.tabs-icon` `.tabs-in-bar` `.tabs-label` `.tabs-outline-tab` `.tabs-outline-tab:selected` `.tabs-pills-tab` `.tabs-pills-tab:selected` `.tabs-shoulder` `.tabs-shoulder-left` `.tabs-shoulder-right` `.tabs-spinner` `.tabs-square` `.tabs-square-tab` `.tabs-square-tab:hover` `.tabs-square-tab:selected` `.tabs-tab` `.tabs-tab:hover` `.tabs-tab:selected` `.tabs-underline` `.tabs-underline-tab` `.tabs-underline-tab:hover` `.tabs-underline-tab:selected`

```lua
local tabs = use "tabs"

tabs {
	variant = "pills", -- underline, outline, cards, compact, classic, square, curved, browser (with width = 200)
	selected = state.tab, add = "new-tab",
	tabs = {
		{ id = "api", label = "ledger-api", icon = "square-terminal", status = "working" },
		{ id = "docs", label = "harbor-docs", icon = "agent-codex", status = "blocked", badge = 2 },
		{ id = "forge", label = "pixel-forge", icon = "agent-claude", status = "done" },
		{ id = "notes", label = "notes.md", icon = "file", status = "idle" },
	},
}
-- update: msg.select picks a tab, msg.close closes one, msg.tab_menu
-- (right-click) opens a menu, "new-tab" adds one.
```

#### `title-bar`

**Title bar.** A unified window title bar: traffic-light inset, leading slot, back/forward, tabs or a title, actions, window buttons; drags the window.

**When:** The top row of a window whose shell sets `titlebar = "hidden"`: pass `window = app.window` and it leaves room for macOS's traffic lights or draws its own window buttons elsewhere. Put `tabs` in its content. For a bar along the bottom use `status-bar`; for a path inside a pane use `breadcrumbs`; for a plain row of buttons use `toolbar`.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `[children]` | the content: tabs, a title, a search field |
| `actions` | elements on the right (icon buttons, a branch menu, an avatar) |
| `back` | msg for a back arrow; giving `back` or `forward` shows both arrows |
| `can_back` | false greys out the back arrow |
| `can_forward` | false greys out the forward arrow |
| `center` | centre the content between the two sides |
| `forward` | msg for a forward arrow |
| `inset` | left padding for macOS's traffic lights, in pixels (default 76 on macOS with a hidden title bar out of full screen, else 10) |
| `leading` | elements right after the inset (a sidebar toggle) |
| `title` | text shown when there is no content |
| `to` | mod to send the arrows' msgs to, if not the drawing one |
| `window` | `app.window`: the platform and title bar mode decide the inset and the window buttons |

**Styles:** `.title-bar` `.title-bar-close:hover` `.title-bar-controls` `.title-bar-inactive` `.title-bar-title`

```lua
local title_bar = use "title-bar"
local tabs = use "tabs"
local icon_button = use "icon-button"

title_bar {
	window = app.window,
	leading = { icon_button { icon = "panel-left", tooltip = "Toggle sidebar", msg = "toggle-sidebar" } },
	back = "back", forward = "forward", can_forward = false,
	actions = { icon_button { icon = "columns-2", tooltip = "Split right", msg = "split" } },
	tabs { selected = state.tab, add = "new-tab", tabs = {
		{ id = "editor", label = "editor", icon = "terminal" },
		{ id = "lazygit", label = "lazygit", icon = "git-branch" },
	} },
}
```

A whole mod using it, with state: `app/components/demos/title-bar.luau`.

### Overlays

#### `about`

**About.** An About box: app icon, name, version and tagline, build info key-values, links and a copyright line.

**When:** Help > About, or the top of a settings General page (`inline`). For the changes in a version use `release-notes`; for other properties use `key-values`; for a first-run welcome use `onboarding`.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `copy` | text a Copy button puts on the clipboard (version and build, for bug reports) |
| `copyright` | small muted line at the bottom |
| `dismiss` | msg for Escape, the × and backdrop clicks |
| `icon` | the app icon (an icon name); default `square-terminal` |
| `image` | a picture path for `ui.image` instead of the icon |
| `info` | build details as { label, value } pairs (Commit, Built, Channel) |
| `inline` | draw only the card, without the modal |
| `links` | list of { label, msg, icon }: Website, Release notes, Report an issue |
| `name` | the app's name |
| `open` | show it |
| `tagline` | a muted line under the version |
| `to` | mod the links send to, if not the drawing one |
| `version` | version text |
| `width` | pixels; default 360 |

**Styles:** `.about` `.about-card` `.about-close` `.about-close:hover` `.about-copyright` `.about-image` `.about-info` `.about-info-label` `.about-info-value` `.about-link` `.about-link:hover` `.about-links` `.about-logo` `.about-name` `.about-tagline` `.about-version`

```lua
local about = use "about"

about { copy = "Moonframe 1.4.0 (beta 2) 6731aec macOS 26 arm64", copyright = "© 2026 Fabien Penso", dismiss = "close", icon = "square-terminal", info = { { "Commit", "6731aec" }, { "Built", "2026-10-28 14:02" }, { "Channel", "beta" }, { "Platform", "macOS 26 · arm64" } }, links = { { icon = "globe", label = "Website", msg = "open-website" }, { icon = "file-text", label = "Release notes", msg = "open-notes" }, { icon = "bug", label = "Report an issue", msg = "report" } }, name = "Moonframe", open = true, tagline = "Terminals, agents and worktrees in one window.", version = "1.4.0 (beta 2)" }
```

#### `action-tiles`

**Action tiles.** Popover content: a header, a grid of large icon tiles, plain rows and a destructive row; sends { action = id }.

**When:** The menu a workspace, worktree or agent opens on click, when its few main actions deserve big targets (new worktree, fan out, rename, close). Wrap it in `ui.popover`. For a plain list of commands use `menu` or `context-menu`; for a yes/no question use `confirm`; for picking one of several options use `choice-cards`.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `columns` | tiles per row (default 3) |
| `destructive` | one red row at the bottom: { id, icon?, label, msg? } |
| `event` | key of the default msg; default `action`, sending `{ action = id }` |
| `rows` | plain rows under the tiles: { id, icon?, label, detail? (muted, right), msg? } |
| `subtitle` | muted line under it (the branch) |
| `tiles` | list of { id, icon, label, accent? (tinted, the main action), disabled?, tooltip?, msg? } |
| `title` | header title (the workspace's name) |
| `to` | mod to send the msgs to, if not the drawing one |
| `trailing` | element on the header's right (a status chip, an icon button) |
| `width` | content width in pixels, for the tile sizes (default 320; match the popover's width minus its padding) |

**Styles:** `.action-tiles` `.action-tiles-destructive` `.action-tiles-destructive:hover` `.action-tiles-grid` `.action-tiles-header` `.action-tiles-row` `.action-tiles-row:hover` `.action-tiles-row-detail` `.action-tiles-row-icon` `.action-tiles-subtitle` `.action-tiles-tile` `.action-tiles-tile:hover` `.action-tiles-tile-accent` `.action-tiles-tile-accent:hover` `.action-tiles-tile-disabled` `.action-tiles-tile-icon` `.action-tiles-tile-label` `.action-tiles-title`

```lua
local action_tiles = use "action-tiles"

ui.popover { open = state.menu == id, dismiss = "close-menu", width = 344,
	content = action_tiles {
		title = "feat-multi-currency", subtitle = "feat/multi-currency",
		tiles = loose {
			{ id = "worktree", icon = "plus", label = "New worktree", accent = true },
			{ id = "fan-out", icon = "git-compare", label = "Fan out" },
			{ id = "rename", icon = "pencil", label = "Rename" },
		},
		rows = { { id = "checkpoints", icon = "history", label = "Checkpoints…" } },
		destructive = { id = "delete", icon = "trash-2", label = "Delete worktree checkout" },
	},
	ui.row { msg = { menu = id }, ui.icon "ellipsis" },
}
-- update: msg.action is the chosen tile or row id.
```

#### `command-palette`

**Command Palette.** A search field over commands that filters as you type, with ↑↓, ↩ and Esc; grouped while empty, ranked while filtering, in several looks.

**When:** Run any of the app's or a mod's commands from the keyboard (⌘K, ⌘⇧P), or jump to a file, branch or workspace by name. For a menu under a button use `dropdown`; for right-click actions use `context-menu`; for a list of shortcuts to read use `shortcuts`; for a search box over a list in a pane use `search-field`.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `commands` | list of { id, label, icon?, detail?, shortcut? (kbd keys, "cmd-t"), group?, keywords?, disabled? } |
| `dismiss` | message sent to the parent on Esc or a click outside |
| `empty` | text when nothing matches (default "No matching commands") |
| `event` | key of the message sent to the parent when a command runs, default "run": { run = id } |
| `id` | keeps its query and highlight; one per id (default "main") |
| `look` | spotlight (default), classic, compact or cards, or a look the stylesheet defines; else the stylesheet's `looks.palette` |
| `open` | show it; reopening starts with an empty query |
| `placeholder` | grey text in the empty field (default "Type a command…") |
| `prefix` | a scope chip before the field, such as "Go to file" |
| `rows` | most rows shown before the list scrolls (default 8) |
| `width` | pixels (default per look, 560 for spotlight) |

**Styles:** `.command-palette` `.command-palette-cards` `.command-palette-cards-field` `.command-palette-cards-input` `.command-palette-cards-list` `.command-palette-cards-row` `.command-palette-cards-row:selected` `.command-palette-classic` `.command-palette-classic-field` `.command-palette-classic-input` `.command-palette-classic-list` `.command-palette-classic-row` `.command-palette-classic-row:selected` `.command-palette-compact` `.command-palette-compact-field` `.command-palette-compact-input` `.command-palette-compact-list` `.command-palette-compact-row` `.command-palette-detail` `.command-palette-disabled` `.command-palette-empty` `.command-palette-field` `.command-palette-field-icon` `.command-palette-footer` `.command-palette-heading` `.command-palette-icon` `.command-palette-input` `.command-palette-list` `.command-palette-prefix` `.command-palette-row` `.command-palette-row:hover` `.command-palette-row:selected` `.command-palette-spotlight` `.command-palette-spotlight-field` `.command-palette-spotlight-input` `.command-palette-tag` `.command-palette-tile` `.command-palette-tile:selected`

```lua
local command_palette = use "command-palette"

-- in view (the mod opens it from a shortcut or a menu):
command_palette {
	open = state.palette, dismiss = "close-palette",
	look = "spotlight", -- classic, compact, cards
	commands = {
		{ id = "new-tab", label = "New terminal tab", icon = "terminal", shortcut = "cmd-t", group = "Terminal" },
		{ id = "branch", label = "Switch branch…", icon = "git-branch", detail = "main", group = "Git" },
	},
}
-- in update: msg.run is the chosen command's id (close it there);
-- "close-palette" closes it.
```
