#### `confirm`

**Confirm.** A small modal question with a message, optional detail and affected items, and Cancel / Confirm buttons.

**When:** Ask before doing something, especially destructive (close a window with running agents, delete a branch). For a modal with a form or custom body use `dialog`; for an undo-able action prefer doing it and showing a `toast` with an Undo action.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `cancel` | msg sent by Cancel, Escape and the backdrop; default `"cancel"` |
| `cancel_label` | cancel button text; default "Cancel" |
| `confirm` | msg sent by the confirm button and ⌘↩; default `"confirm"` |
| `confirm_label` | confirm button text; default "Confirm" |
| `danger` | red confirm button and a warning icon |
| `detail` | longer muted text in a scrolling box (an error, a path list) |
| `icon` | icon before the title |
| `items` | affected things, listed: strings or { label, detail, icon } |
| `items_title` | heading over `items`, e.g. "Agents that will be interrupted" |
| `message` | one or two lines under the title |
| `open` | show it |
| `title` | the question |
| `to` | mod the buttons send to, if not the drawing one |

**Styles:** `.confirm-detail` `.confirm-item` `.confirm-item-detail` `.confirm-item-icon` `.confirm-items` `.confirm-items-title` `.confirm-message`

```lua
local confirm = use "confirm"

confirm { cancel_label = "Keep open", confirm_label = "Close window", danger = true, items = { { detail = "feature/inspect · writing tests", icon = "agent-claude", label = "Claude" }, { detail = "fix/menus · running cargo test", icon = "agent-codex", label = "Codex" } }, items_title = "Agents that will be interrupted", message = "Closing it interrupts the agents still running here.", open = true, title = "Close this window?" }
```

A whole mod using it, with state: `app/components/demos/confirm.luau`.

#### `context-menu`

**Context Menu.** Any content that opens a menu beside it on a right-click; picking sends { pick = id }.

**When:** Right-click actions on a row, tab, tile or file. It anchors the menu to the wrapped content, not the pointer. For a menu opened by a button use `dropdown`; for the menu rows alone use `menu`. On `tabs`, use its `context` (each tab already sends { tab_menu = id }) and put this around the strip, or a `ui.popover` with `menu`.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `[children]` | the content that takes the right-click (the anchor) |
| `align` | "start" (default) or "end" |
| `context` | message a right-click on the content sends, to open the menu |
| `dismiss` | message sent on a click outside or Escape |
| `event` | key of the message a pick sends, default "pick": { pick = id } |
| `highlighted` | keyboard-highlighted item (id or index) |
| `items` | `menu` items: { id, label, icon?, shortcut?, checked?, danger?, disabled?, detail? }, "separator", { heading = ... } |
| `keys` | keys while open, e.g. { up = "menu-up", down = "menu-down", enter = "menu-choose" }; escape sends `dismiss` |
| `open` | true while the menu shows |
| `side` | "bottom" (default) or "top" |
| `to` | mod to send right-click and pick messages to, if not the drawing one |
| `width` | menu width in pixels (default 220) |

**Styles:** `.context-menu` `.context-menu-popover`

```lua
local context_menu = use "context-menu"

context_menu {
	open = state.menu_open, context = "open-menu", dismiss = "close-menu",
	keys = { up = "menu-up", down = "menu-down", enter = "menu-choose" },
	highlighted = state.menu_index,
	items = {
		{ id = "open", label = "Open", icon = "external-link" },
		{ id = "copy-path", label = "Copy path", icon = "copy" },
		"separator",
		{ id = "delete", label = "Move to Trash", icon = "trash-2", danger = true },
	},
	ui.item { "README.md", detail = "~/code/app" },
}
-- update: "open-menu" sets state.menu_open; msg.pick runs the action and
-- closes it; "close-menu" closes it.
```

A whole mod using it, with state: `app/components/demos/context-menu.luau`.

#### `dialog`

**Dialog.** A modal card over a dimmed window: header with title, Esc hint and ×, a body, and right-aligned footer buttons.

**When:** Any modal that asks for attention: a form, a choice, details. For a yes/no question use `confirm`; for a panel sliding from an edge use `sheet`; for a non-blocking message use `toast` or `notice`; for content beside a control use `ui.popover`.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `[children]` | the body |
| `actions` | footer elements instead of `buttons` |
| `backdrop` | dim the window behind; default true |
| `buttons` | footer buttons { { label, msg, variant, disabled } }, right-aligned |
| `class` | extra class on the card |
| `close` | show the × button; default true |
| `dismiss` | msg sent by Escape, a backdrop click or the × |
| `height` | pixels for the body, which then scrolls |
| `hint` | show the Esc key hint in the header; default true |
| `icon` | icon before the title |
| `keys` | more keys for the overlay, merged with escape and submit |
| `note` | muted text on the footer's left |
| `open` | show it |
| `place` | overlay placement, default `center` (`top` for a palette-like dialog) |
| `plain` | no lines between header, body and footer (alerts, confirmations) |
| `size` | `small` (360), `medium` (480, default) or `large` (640) |
| `submit` | msg sent by secondary-enter (⌘↩ / Ctrl+Enter) |
| `subtitle` | muted line under the title |
| `title` | header title |
| `to` | mod the buttons and × send to, if not the drawing one |
| `tone` | icon color: `accent` (default), `success`, `warning` or `danger` |
| `width` | pixels, instead of `size` |

**Styles:** `.dialog` `.dialog-body` `.dialog-close` `.dialog-close:hover` `.dialog-footer` `.dialog-footer-plain` `.dialog-header` `.dialog-header-plain` `.dialog-hint` `.dialog-icon` `.dialog-icon-danger` `.dialog-icon-success` `.dialog-icon-warning` `.dialog-note` `.dialog-subtitle` `.dialog-title`

```lua
local dialog = use "dialog"

dialog { open = state.renaming, dismiss = "close", title = "Rename workspace",
	subtitle = "moonframe · ~/code/moonframe", icon = "pencil", size = "small", submit = "save",
	buttons = { { label = "Cancel", msg = "close", variant = "ghost" }, { label = "Rename", msg = "save", variant = "primary" } },
	ui.text "The new name shows in the sidebar and the window title.",
}
```

A whole mod using it, with state: `app/components/demos/dialog.luau`.

#### `menu`

**Menu.** Menu rows (icon, label, check, detail, shortcut, danger) with separators and headings; a click sends { pick = id }.

**When:** The content of any menu: put it in a `ui.popover` or `ui.overlay` yourself, or use `dropdown` (a button that opens one) or `context-menu` (opens on right-click), which already do. For a selectable sidebar list use `list`; for a command palette with a search field use `command-palette`.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `event` | key of the message a click sends, default "pick": { pick = id } |
| `highlighted` | the keyboard-highlighted row: an item id, or its index in `items` |
| `items` | list of { id, label, icon?, shortcut? (kbd keys, "cmd-s"), checked? (true/false shows the check column), danger?, disabled?, detail? (muted text on the right), msg? (sent instead of the default) }, the string "separator", or { heading = "Text" } |
| `to` | mod to send messages to, if not the drawing one |

**Styles:** `.menu` `.menu-check` `.menu-detail` `.menu-heading` `.menu-icon` `.menu-item` `.menu-item:hover` `.menu-item:selected` `.menu-item-danger` `.menu-item-danger:hover` `.menu-item-danger-icon` `.menu-item-disabled` `.menu-separator`

```lua
local menu = use "menu"

menu { highlighted = "rename", items = { { heading = "Tab" }, { icon = "pencil", id = "rename", label = "Rename…", shortcut = "cmd-r" }, { icon = "copy", id = "duplicate", label = "Duplicate", shortcut = "cmd-d" }, { checked = true, icon = "pin", id = "pin", label = "Pin tab" }, { detail = "2 panes", icon = "columns-2", id = "split", label = "Split right" }, { disabled = true, icon = "folder-open", id = "reveal", label = "Reveal in Finder" }, "separator", { danger = true, icon = "close", id = "close", label = "Close tab", shortcut = "cmd-w" } } }
```

A whole mod using it, with state: `app/components/demos/menu.luau`.

#### `notification-drawer`

**Notification Drawer.** A side drawer of notifications: Mark all read and ×, filter tabs with a sliding pill and counts, and cards with a status icon, title, one line, time and a coloured tag.

**When:** The app's notification centre, opened from a bell: a list the user filters by kind (All, Error, Success, Info), marks read and dismisses. For transient pop-ups use `toasts`; for a message that stays in the page use `notice`; for any other side panel use `sheet`.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `backdrop` | dim the window behind (default true) |
| `dismiss` | msg sent by ×, Escape and a click outside |
| `empty` | text when the chosen tab has nothing (default "You're all caught up") |
| `event` | key of the msg a tab sends, default "filter": { filter = id } |
| `filter` | id of the chosen filter tab (default the first) |
| `filters` | tabs: { id, label, levels? (the levels it shows; none shows all), count? }; default All / Error / Success / Info |
| `items` | list of { id, title, body?, time?, level? (error, success, info, warning), tag? (the tag's word; default the level's), read?, msg? (sent on a click) }, newest first |
| `mark_read` | msg the Mark all read link sends; no link without it |
| `mark_read_label` | the link's text (default "Mark all read") |
| `open` | show it |
| `remove` | key of the msg an item's × sends, default "remove": { remove = id }; false hides the × |
| `title` | header title (default "Notification") |
| `to` | mod to send every msg to, if not the drawing one |
| `top` | pixels to leave above it, to keep a top bar in view (default 0) |
| `width` | pixels (default 420) |

**Styles:** `.notification-drawer` `.notification-drawer-body` `.notification-drawer-close` `.notification-drawer-close:hover` `.notification-drawer-count` `.notification-drawer-count:selected` `.notification-drawer-dot` `.notification-drawer-empty` `.notification-drawer-error` `.notification-drawer-head` `.notification-drawer-info` `.notification-drawer-item` `.notification-drawer-item:hover` `.notification-drawer-item-title` `.notification-drawer-item-title-read` `.notification-drawer-list` `.notification-drawer-offset` `.notification-drawer-pill` `.notification-drawer-pill-row` `.notification-drawer-read` `.notification-drawer-read:hover` `.notification-drawer-read-item` `.notification-drawer-read-item:hover` `.notification-drawer-remove` `.notification-drawer-remove:hover` `.notification-drawer-success` `.notification-drawer-tab` `.notification-drawer-tab:hover` `.notification-drawer-tab:selected` `.notification-drawer-tabs` `.notification-drawer-tag` `.notification-drawer-tag-text` `.notification-drawer-tile` `.notification-drawer-time` `.notification-drawer-title` `.notification-drawer-track` `.notification-drawer-unread` `.notification-drawer-warning`

```lua
local notification_drawer = use "notification-drawer"

notification_drawer {
	open = state.open, dismiss = "close", mark_read = "read-all",
	filter = state.filter, items = state.items, -- { id, title, body, time, level, read }
}
-- update: msg.filter picks a tab, msg.remove drops an item,
-- "read-all" sets every item's read, "close" sets state.open = false.
```

A whole mod using it, with state: `app/components/demos/notification-drawer.luau`.

#### `onboarding`

**Onboarding.** A first-run welcome card: logo, title and BETA badge, one tour page at a time, pager dots, Back / Next / Done; arrows and Enter move.

**When:** A short guided tour or welcome on first launch or after a big update. For one release's changes use `release-notes`; for a single question use `confirm`; for any other modal use `dialog`.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `[children]` | the body instead of `pages` |
| `back` | msg for Back and ←; default `"back"` |
| `badge` | a badge after the title ("BETA") |
| `current` | index of the page shown (1-based); default 1 |
| `dismiss` | msg for ×, Escape and backdrop clicks; default the `done` msg |
| `done` | msg for Done (and ↩ on the last page); default `"done"` |
| `done_label` | default "Get started" |
| `event` | key of the msg a pager dot sends; default `page`: { page = index } |
| `icon` | logo icon in the header; default `sparkles` |
| `next` | msg for Next and → / ↩; default `"next"` |
| `open` | show it |
| `pages` | list of { icon, title, text, media, content = { elements } } |
| `title` | header title; default "Welcome" |
| `to` | mod the buttons send to, if not the drawing one |
| `width` | pixels; default 520 |

**Styles:** `.onboarding` `.onboarding-body` `.onboarding-close` `.onboarding-close:hover` `.onboarding-footer` `.onboarding-header` `.onboarding-logo` `.onboarding-media` `.onboarding-page-icon` `.onboarding-page-text` `.onboarding-page-title` `.onboarding-title`

```lua
local onboarding = use "onboarding"

onboarding { badge = "BETA", current = 2, icon = "sparkles", open = true, pages = { { icon = "terminal", text = "Every workspace keeps its panes, tabs and scrollback across restarts.", title = "Terminals that remember" }, { icon = "bot", text = "Start Claude, Codex or Gemini in their own worktrees and watch them from the sidebar.", title = "Run agents side by side" }, { icon = "globe", text = "Add SSH hosts and cloud devices; Moonframe reconnects when they drop.", title = "Your machines, one window" } }, title = "Welcome to Moonframe" }
```

A whole mod using it, with state: `app/components/demos/onboarding.luau`.

#### `sheet`

**Sheet.** A panel sliding in from the left, right or bottom edge, with a header (title, actions, ×), a scrolling body and a footer.

**When:** Side content that needs room but should keep the window in view: details, an inspector, a settings pane, logs. For a centred modal use `dialog`; for a permanent side panel use a `ui.pane` in a split; for a small floating card by a control use `ui.popover`.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `[children]` | the body, which scrolls |
| `actions` | elements in the header before the × |
| `backdrop` | dim the window behind; default true |
| `dismiss` | msg sent by Escape, a backdrop click or the × |
| `footer` | an element pinned under the body (buttons, a status) |
| `height` | pixels for a bottom sheet; default 320 |
| `icon` | icon before the title |
| `keys` | more keys for the overlay |
| `open` | show it |
| `side` | `right` (default), `left` or `bottom` |
| `subtitle` | muted line under the title |
| `title` | header title |
| `to` | mod the × sends to, if not the drawing one |
| `width` | pixels for a left or right sheet; default 380 |

**Styles:** `.sheet` `.sheet-body` `.sheet-close` `.sheet-close:hover` `.sheet-footer` `.sheet-header` `.sheet-icon` `.sheet-subtitle` `.sheet-title`

```lua
local sheet = use "sheet"

sheet { open = state.details, dismiss = "close-details", title = "Pull request #482",
	subtitle = "feature/inspect → main", icon = "git-pull-request",
	ui.text "Body content scrolls here.",
}
```

A whole mod using it, with state: `app/components/demos/sheet.luau`.

#### `shortcuts`

**Shortcuts.** A keyboard shortcut reference: groups of key caps and labels laid out in columns in a large modal.

**When:** Show the app's or a mod's keybindings (a ? or ⌘/ help overlay, a Shortcuts page). For one shortcut use `kbd`; for a line of hints under a list or palette use `key-hints`; for a command palette use `command-palette`.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `columns` | number of columns; default 2 |
| `dismiss` | msg for Escape, the × and backdrop clicks |
| `groups` | list of { title, items = { { keys = "cmd-shift-p", label, msg } } }; a `msg` makes the row clickable |
| `height` | pixels for the scrolling body |
| `inline` | draw the groups in place, without the modal |
| `note` | footer text; default "esc to close" |
| `open` | show it |
| `search` | an element over the groups, such as a search input |
| `subtitle` | muted line under the title |
| `title` | default "Keyboard Shortcuts" |
| `to` | mod the rows send to, if not the drawing one |
| `width` | pixels; default 720 |

**Styles:** `.shortcuts-column` `.shortcuts-columns` `.shortcuts-group` `.shortcuts-group-title` `.shortcuts-label` `.shortcuts-none` `.shortcuts-row` `.shortcuts-row:hover`

```lua
local shortcuts = use "shortcuts"

shortcuts { dismiss = "close", groups = { { items = { { keys = "cmd-shift-n", label = "New workspace" }, { keys = "cmd-t", label = "New tab" }, { keys = "cmd-d", label = "Split right" }, { keys = "cmd-shift-d", label = "Split down" }, { keys = "cmd-w", label = "Close pane" } }, title = "Workspaces & panes" }, { items = { { keys = "cmd-k", label = "Command palette" }, { keys = "cmd-p", label = "Go to workspace" }, { keys = "cmd-alt-left", label = "Previous pane" }, { keys = "cmd-alt-right", label = "Next pane" } }, title = "Navigation" }, { items = { { keys = "cmd-shift-a", label = "Start agent" }, { keys = "cmd-k cmd-r", label = "Review changes" }, { keys = "", label = "Edit worktree note" } }, title = "Agents" } }, open = true, subtitle = "View and edit shortcuts", width = 600 }
```

A whole mod using it, with state: `app/components/demos/shortcuts.luau`.

### Status

#### `status-dot`

**Status Dot.** An agent's state as a coloured dot: working, blocked, done, idle (hollow ring) or unknown; spins or becomes a "Needs you" pill.

**When:** Show the state of an agent, job or session beside its name: in sidebar rows, tabs and lists. Use `chip = true` where the state must catch the eye (a blocked agent). For a count use `count-bubble`; for a PR's state use `pr-badge`; for CI results use `checks`.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `chip` | show a pill with the dot and a label ("Needs you" when blocked) |
| `label` | the chip's text instead of the default for the status |
| `size` | small \| normal \| large (dot diameter 6, 8, 10) |
| `spin` | when working, show a spinning loader instead of the dot |
| `status` | working \| blocked \| done \| idle \| unknown (default unknown) |
| `tooltip` | text under the pointer |

**Styles:** `.status-dot` `.status-dot-blocked` `.status-dot-chip` `.status-dot-chip-blocked` `.status-dot-chip-done` `.status-dot-chip-idle` `.status-dot-chip-label` `.status-dot-chip-working` `.status-dot-done` `.status-dot-idle` `.status-dot-spin` `.status-dot-unknown` `.status-dot-working`

```lua
local status_dot = use "status-dot"

ui.row { align = "center", gap = "normal",
	status_dot { status = "working", spin = true },
	status_dot { status = "blocked" },
	status_dot { status = "done" },
	status_dot { status = "idle" },
	status_dot { status = "unknown" },
	status_dot { status = "blocked", chip = true },
}
```

A whole mod using it, with state: `app/components/demos/status-dot.luau`.

### Status bar

#### `stat`

**Stat.** An icon, an optional label, and a value in a fixed-width box, for status bars and toolbars.

**When:** One labelled value with an icon in a status bar or toolbar, kept to a fixed width so it does not jitter.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `icon` | icon name |
| `label` | short label |
| `tone` | text tone |
| `value` | the value text |
| `width` | value width in pixels |

```lua
local stat = use "stat"

stat { icon = "cpu", label = "CPU", value = "12%", width = 32 }
```

A whole mod using it, with state: `app/components/demos/stat.luau`.

#### `status-bar`

**Status bar.** A thin footer bar with left and right items (elements, text, or { icon, text, tone, msg }) and optional separators.

**When:** The window's bottom bar: machine, branch, agent counts on the left; CPU, theme, shortcuts on the right. Put `stat`, `meter` or `sparkline` in it for live readings. For a coloured strip announcing something use `banner`; for a top row use `title-bar`; for an extensible bar, give it a `ui.region` as an item.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `left` | items on the left: elements, strings, or { icon, text, tone? (muted, accent, success, warning, danger), msg?, to?, tooltip?, mono? } |
| `right` | items pushed to the right, same shapes |
| `separators` | thin vertical rules between items |
| `to` | mod to send the items' msgs to, if not the drawing one |

**Styles:** `.status-bar` `.status-bar-accent` `.status-bar-button` `.status-bar-button:hover` `.status-bar-danger` `.status-bar-group` `.status-bar-item` `.status-bar-mono` `.status-bar-muted` `.status-bar-separator` `.status-bar-success` `.status-bar-warning`

```lua
local status_bar = use "status-bar"

status_bar {
	left = {
		{ icon = "laptop", text = "This computer" },
		{ icon = "git-branch", text = app.git and app.git.branch or "main", mono = true },
		{ text = "4 agents" },
		{ text = "· 1 needs you", tone = "danger", msg = "show-blocked" },
	},
	right = {
		{ icon = "cpu", text = "CPU 27%" },
		{ icon = "sun", text = "Theme", msg = "toggle-theme" },
		{ icon = "keyboard", text = "Shortcuts", msg = "shortcuts" },
	},
}
```

A whole mod using it, with state: `app/components/demos/status-bar.luau`.

### Terminals

#### `ghostty-terminal`

**Ghostty terminal.** A live shell on libghostty-vt, Ghostty's own emulator. It keeps running across reloads and while hidden.

**When:** A shell drawn by Ghostty's emulator; same as `terminal` with the other engine.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `backend` | `auto` (default), `herdr-core`, `tmux` or `pty` |
| `cwd` | starting folder |
| `id` | keeps the shell across reloads; one per id |
| `style` | style table for the box |

```lua
local ghostty_terminal = use "ghostty-terminal"

ghostty_terminal { cwd = "~", id = "shell" }
```

A whole mod using it, with state: `app/components/demos/ghostty-terminal.luau`.

#### `terminal`

**Terminal.** A live shell on alacritty_terminal, the pure-Rust emulator. It keeps running across reloads and while hidden.

**When:** A live shell (alacritty engine) filling its space: a pane, a bottom panel.

| Prop | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `backend` | `auto` (default), `herdr-core`, `tmux` or `pty` |
| `cwd` | starting folder |
| `id` | keeps the shell across reloads; one per id |
| `style` | style table for the box |

```lua
local terminal = use "terminal"

terminal { cwd = "~", id = "shell" }
```

A whole mod using it, with state: `app/components/demos/terminal.luau`.
